name: Put.io transfers
description: Runs magnets and torrent files as transfers on a Put.io account.

codes.putio_transfers.auth_invalid: The Put.io sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again.
codes.putio_transfers.disk_full: The Put.io account has no space left for this transfer.
codes.putio_transfers.no_content: Put.io reports this transfer as finished but names no files
codes.putio_transfers.no_remote_selection: Put.io downloads a whole torrent and offers no file selection before it does. Choose the files in the LinkGrabber.
codes.putio_transfers.no_transfer_id: Put.io did not name the transfer it created. Check your Put.io account before trying again.
codes.putio_transfers.not_a_torrent: This is not a magnet address or a torrent file
codes.putio_transfers.not_permitted: Put.io does not allow this account to do that
codes.putio_transfers.rate_limited: The Put.io API rate limit was reached. Waiting.
codes.putio_transfers.too_many_files: This Put.io transfer holds more files than rDownloader will take in one job
codes.putio_transfers.transfer_cancelled: This transfer was cancelled at Put.io
codes.putio_transfers.transfer_failed: Put.io ended this transfer with an error
codes.putio_transfers.transfer_gone: Put.io no longer holds this transfer
